note: Candidate shared settings from the 22/11/2026 plan (docs/planning/dk2-dk4-improvement-2026-11-22.md, section 3): shared.json with rrf_candidates 100 (hybrid fusion over the first 100 BM25 and dense candidates instead of 30) for every condition including DK1, and context_packing P3 (pack-article-v1 tree layout with short document names) for DK2-DK4; DK1 always packs P0. validity_note: Date of a question without as_of in validity conditions: the freeze date of corpus v3, decided 15/11/2026 (docs/decisions.md). Runs record the date per question (validity.as_of, as_of_source) and preflight fails when validity conditions of one comparison used different defaults.
